appendix.fallback_scale_note: These test years have no earlier year to fit the utility scale on and fall back to the predeclared theoretical value. The utility is divided by the scale, so the fallback amplifies corrections where a fitted scale halves them: their stakes and claimed edges are several times any fitted year's and are not comparable with them. Exclude these years from any return figure -- filter on is_honest_scale in the per-run CSV.

sensitivity.note: fitted on strictly earlier years; fallback to the theoretical value

appendix.settlement_label: Secondary diagnostic. This suite selects on paired race log loss; betting returns cannot select a model and are not evidence for or against a probit candidate.

training_window.detail: the training start year is not recorded in this run's metadata
training_window.sentence: These are walk-forward figures rather than one model's: the model is refitted for each evaluation year on the seasons before it, so the result concatenates 11 separately fitted models and no evaluation year's outcomes appear in its own fit. This run did not record the year its training window starts, so this report does not name one.
training_window.summary: 11 separate fits, one per evaluation year

appendix.unverifiable_gates: An interaction diagnostic across predeclared cohorts, reproduction from a clean identified commit, and confirmation on a future prospective period are not derivable from these artifacts. Production remains the five-seed Softmax Offset ensemble until they are met.

utility_scale.theory_source: the scale the fallback year used, which is the predeclared theoretical value

effects.reason: This architecture has no model-specific learned features to attribute.

ensemble.reason: There is no ensemble to be stable. This architecture is one choice link applied to one set of mean utilities, not a bag of independently fitted members, so seed variation here is integration noise rather than model disagreement -- and that is reported beside the paired diagnostic instead.

topchoice.reason: This run has no standalone top-choice movement artifact.

identity.label: Probit Offset Boosted
identity.market_reference: the market's own implied probabilities on the same races, normalised within each race

assumptions: Model probabilities are assumed exactly correct.
Historical Win Odds are held fixed and used as the gross return proxy.
Race opportunities and chronology are as observed.
Winners are drawn independently per race from the stored probabilities.
The model is not refitted inside a replicate.
Model error, drift, market response and regime change are excluded.
model_assumed.label: Rebate-aware Kelly, large-bank limit
model_assumed.large_bank_caveat: The rebate threshold is treated as always met. This is a scale-free asymptotic policy, not the exact finite HK$1B bankroll scenario.
model_assumed.population_rule: every race in the standardized evaluation window that the settlement can settle, not the subset this model staked. An unstaked race has multiplier exactly 1 under both policies, so including it changes no terminal figure; excluding it made the race sequence -- and with it the checkpoints and the shared random draws -- a property of the model, which is what stopped two reports' fan charts being comparable.
model_assumed.rounding_treatment: omitted; minimum-bet rounding vanishes in the scale-free limit
